learning_outcomes.text: Ability to use vector algebra and perform calculations with vector differential operators.
Ability to calculate electrostatic field, force, and potential.
Ability to calculate fields in conductive and dielectric materials.
Ability to calculate static magnetic field and force.
Ability to solve problems related to static magnetic fields in magnetic materials.
Ability to solve electromagnetic field problems using Faraday's and Ampere's laws.

syllabus_topics: Differential operators, gradient, divergence and curl, Gauss and Stokes theorems
Introduction to static electric fields, Coulomb's law
Electrostatic field in free space, field lines, electrostatic potential and work
Gauss and Poisson relations, static electric field in material bodies
Concept of polarization, dielectric and conductive bodies, boundary conditions
Capacitance and capacitor, electrostatic energy density
Static magnetic field in vacuum, Lorentz force, steady current and Biot-Savart law
Circulation of the magnetic field, Ampere's law
Vector potential and basic equations related to static magnetic fields
Static magnetic field and boundary conditions in material bodies, Magnetic circuits
Faraday's and Ampere's laws for time-varying fields
Maxwell's equations and fundamentals of electrodynamics
